WITH invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    COUNT(i.invoice_number) as invoice_count
  FROM Orders o
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_count,
    CAST(invoice_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () as share,
    AVG(CAST(invoice_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / SUM(invoice_count) OVER ()) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM invoice_counts
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_count,
    share,
    avg_share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess
FROM above_avg
